reviews.name: Stephanie
reviews.text: I highly recommend Mrs. Akbar! She is an amazing instructor! She is always punctual, polite, and extremely friendly! She is so patient, calm, kind, encouraging, supportive and accommodating too! She completely helped me overcome my test anxiety by practicing driving manoeuvres and parallel parking over and over again with me until i felt 100% confident. Thanks to her incredible teaching, i was able to pass my g2 on my first try! She gave me such good tips and advice for my test and helped me to build up my skills. Her husband drove me to the test centre today and they are both so kind, incredibly nice and supportive. They are wonderful people! ❤️

reviews.name: Rose Nyarko
reviews.text: Mrs. Akbar is an excellent driving instructor. She gives clear instructions, she's patient, kind and very motivating. She made parallel parking and reverse parking easy to learn and understand. I highly recommend her to anyone looking for a professional and supportive driving instructor.

reviews.name: priyanka saha
reviews.text: I had a great experience learning with Mrs. Akbar. She was incredibly polite, patient, and understanding throughout all my lessons. As a nervous driver, her calm and reassuring approach really helped me build confidence behind the wheel. She explained everything clearly, never rushed me, and always made me feel comfortable. I truly appreciate her patience and kindness, and I would highly recommend her to anyone, especially nervous or first-time drivers.

reviews.name: Sarah
reviews.text: One of the best instructors you can find! Mrs. Akbar is so patient and kind, especially helpful for anxious drivers. She taught me proper driving techniques, road test rules and tips to ensure I pass my G2 test, which I did in first attempt. I highly recommend her to anyone looking to take their test soon!

reviews.name: SARANYAJIT NANDI
reviews.text: Mrs. Akbar is an excellent driving instructor. She is extremely patient, calm, and very clear in her instructions, which made me feel confident behind the wheel from the beginning. I truly appreciate her professionalism and supportive teaching style. I would highly recommend her to anyone looking for a knowledgeable and reliable driving instructor.

reviews.name: Gaurav Singh
reviews.text: From the very first lesson, my instructor was extremely patient, calm, and professional. She took the time to clearly explain all G2 test requirements, Ontario road rules, and proper driving techniques. Each lesson was well planned and focused on the exact skills needed to pass the test, including lane changes, parallel parking, three-point turns, uphill/downhill parking, proper mirror checks, and defensive driving. Because of her I passed my G2 road test in first attempt. She is really nice and kind hearted person. I would like to recommend everyone who wants to clear their road test in first attempt. Thanks a lot mam😊☺️
